# Bicep

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from bicep/lang.json and bicep/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

This page helps you build, test and check Bicep code with rules_dx.

## Quick start

`MODULE.bazel` sits at the root of your repository and lists the Bazel modules, meaning external dependencies, that your project uses. Add `rules_dx` to it:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

Then let dx set up the rest, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart):

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init --apply
```

For a Bicep project, `MODULE.bazel` then looks like this:

```python
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

A `BUILD.bazel` file declares targets: the libraries, binaries and tests that Bazel builds. This one is a small Bicep package from [`bicep/tests/consumer`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/bicep/tests/consumer/BUILD.bazel):

```python
load("@rules_dx//bicep:defs.bzl", "bicep_library")

bicep_library(
    name = "bicep",
    srcs = ["main.bicep"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)
```

Build and test everything. `//...` means every target in the repository:

```sh
tools/dx test //...
```

## Rules

`load` brings rules into a `BUILD.bazel` file. Load the ones you use from `@rules_dx//bicep:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//bicep:defs.bzl", "bicep_library", "bicep_registry_module")
```

### `bicep_library`

Owns the Bicep files of one package for dx quality.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Bicep and Bicep parameter files of this package. |
| `data` | `label_list` | no | Files read by load functions; not checked by dx quality. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Bicep modules and registry modules this package depends on. |

### `bicep_registry_module`

A restored Bicep registry module and its cache files.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cache_root` | `string` | no | Repository-relative root of the module cache. |
| `digest` | `string` | no | sha256 of the module manifest. |
| `ref` | `string` | yes | Module reference, br:HOST/PATH:TAG. |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Cached module files. |

## Tools and package files

dx runs these tools and reads these package files for Bicep:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tools | `bicep`, `trivy_config` |
| Ecosystems | bicep |
| Manifests | `*.bicep` |
| Lockfiles | `bicep.lock.json` |

## Platforms

Bicep builds and tests on:

- Linux arm64
- Linux x86_64
- macOS arm64
- Windows arm64
- Windows x86_64
